channel.title: Dad Joke of the Day
channel.description: A fresh dad joke every day. Get the app at dadjokes.vip

item.title: "What's up, dad?"
item.description:
"What's up, dad?"
"It's a movie about an old man and balloons, son".

item.title: "Is this gluten free?"
item.description:
"Is this gluten free?"
"No, it costs money, sir."

item.title: What did the note stuck to the bulletin board say?

help! I'm under a tack!'

item.title: Today I saw two rabbits racing down the road..
item.description:
Today I saw two rabbits racing down the road..
They were the fast and the furriest.

item.title: "Sir, your tests show that your DNA is backwards."
item.description:
"Sir, your tests show that your DNA is backwards."
"AND?!?"

item.title: What did the sign in the doctor's office say?
item.description:
What did the sign in the doctor's office say?
"We have a lot of patience."

item.title: How did the man learn to drive the ice cream truck?
item.description:
How did the man learn to drive the ice cream truck?
He went to sundae school.

item.title: Why did the girl drop out of school?
item.description:

She didn't like the principal of it.

item.title: What did the model say when she started turning gray?
item.description:

I think I'll dye.

item.title: I recently visited a US state north of Texas and south of Kansas.
item.description:
I recently visited a US state north of Texas and south of Kansas.
It wasn’t great… but it was OK.
